title: fix: dates and numbers use the display locale across every @object-ui/i18n dependent, with one repo-wide machine-locale census (objectui#9909)
body:
Fixes #9909
Clause-②: yes

## What this is

The one-time sweep of the machine-locale class across every package that depends on `@object-ui/i18n`, landing together with the ONE repo-wide census test the ruling on objectui#9786 (batch #194 item 4, letter B′, maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-20) asked for. ⛔ No ESLint rule and no new workflow: the census is an ordinary test in `@object-ui/i18n`, and it replaces (it is not added beside) `plugin-detail`'s package-scoped census pin, which this PR deletes.

Every face below handed `Intl` no locale tag, an explicit `undefined`, or the `'default'` pseudo-tag. None of those means "the user's locale": `Intl` reads each of them as the MACHINE's locale, which is neither of this repository's two locale channels. They now read `useDisplayLocale()` (tenant regional default, then the active UI language, then `'en'`), and every plain helper takes the tag from its caller as a REQUIRED parameter (the `formatImportJobTime` shape), except where the helper is a published export, where the new parameter is optional and additive.

## The census this PR reflects

- Tree: `origin/main` `62597c588` (unchanged at the time of the final run), taken **2026-09-24T05:46Z**.
- Instrument: the repo's declared masker, `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs` (self-test: 45 cases pass); nothing hand-rolled. Scope: non-test sources of every workspace package, then partitioned by the manifest rule below.
- Masked vs raw: masked finds 150 locale-taking call sites, raw grep finds 162. The 12 extra raw hits are prose, one of them a comment in `plugin-gantt` that quotes a past repair of this very class.
- Shapes judged: 53 machine-locale-shaped (45 bare, 8 explicit `undefined`), 1 disguised (`'default'`), 6 hard-coded literals. Plus a bounded reading for the half a source scan cannot see (optional-locale helpers called without one): 4 more sites found.
- ⚠️ These figures describe that tree at that minute. The instrument that re-derives the population from now on is the census test itself (`packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts`), per AGENTS.md #9.

## The repo-wide census test

`packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts`, beside `useDisplayLocale.ts`, whose doc comment states the rule it enforces.

- **Population from the manifests**, never listed: every package the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` globs expand to whose `package.json` names `@object-ui/i18n` in any dependency field. A package that gains the dependency is covered with no edit.
- **Refuses** a call passing nothing, `undefined`, or `'default'`, and a hard-coded BCP-47 literal, unless DECLARED with file, expression (cited by content, never by line), exact count and reason.
- **Exact counts both ways**: deleting a declared site without its entry is red, and a second copy of a declared expression is red.
- **The lit control is a negative**: `CommentThread.tsx`'s `catch` must be scanned AND declared.
- Width guards (manifest read, population size, per-package sources, call-site floor; `packages/i18n` and `packages/core` must be OUT), plus a matcher self-test on a fixture.
- `@object-ui/core` is outside by the ruling's rule (no `@object-ui/i18n` dependency, React-free by charter, and its declared contract for a caller with no locale in hand is "follow the runtime default"). Its two rows are repaired by threading below.

The runtime tripwire (`recordLocaleArguments`) moved from `plugin-detail`'s differential pin into the private `@object-ui/test-support`, now also patching `Number.prototype.toLocaleString` (a number face never reaches the global `Intl.NumberFormat`) and counting `'default'` as the machine locale. Every repaired surface is pinned with it: two declared locales (`de-DE` vs `en`, UI language `en` on both) must render differently, and every locale-taking call must receive the declared tag.

## Per-site table

Verdicts: **DEFECT** = this defect; **FALLBACK** = deliberate fallback; **N/A** = not applicable. "(outside)" = not in the census population.

⭐ = invisible to any source scan: the call passes an argument list that merely OMITS the tag to a helper whose locale is optional (`formatCurrency`, `formatCompactCurrency`, `formatDate`). Found by a bounded reading of every call to the optional-locale formatters in `@object-ui/core` / `@object-ui/fields` / `@object-ui/i18n`; pinned by the runtime tripwire.

### DEFECT, NOT repaired here (1)

| Package | Site | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin-ai` (outside) | `NLQueryInput.tsx` · query-history date | The package has no locale channel at all: no `@object-ui/i18n` dependency and every visible string is hard-coded English. The repo's precedent is that an unwired component is wired WHOLE, not one face at a time (objectui#7173, after objectui#7142), and that needs a manifest and lockfile change this card does not own. Carried as a finding. The census catches it by itself: the moment a wiring PR adds the dependency, this exact site turns the census red until it is repaired in that PR. |

### FALLBACK, declared in the census with its reason (7 sites), plus 1 outside

| Package | Site | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `collaboration` ⭐ LIT CONTROL | `CommentThread.tsx` · `formatAbsoluteDate` `catch { return date.toLocaleDateString(); }` | The `try` already passes the session language; the `catch` fires only on the RangeError a structurally malformed tag raises, and restores the pre-localisation face instead of printing the raw ISO string. Repairing it would BE the defect. ⛔ Not touched. |
| `plugin-detail` | `InlineFieldInput.tsx` · `d.toLocaleDateString('en-CA')` | An ISO-8601 formatter feeding a native date input (`input type=date`), whose value is defined as `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `plugin-gantt` | `GanttView.tsx` · `task.start.toLocaleDateString('en-CA')` (×2: double-click and context-menu edit) | The same ISO formatter, seeding the inline editor's date inputs. |

| `plugin-gantt` | `GanttView.tsx` · `tzOffsetMs`'s `new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', …)` | A machine-read parser: `formatToParts` is read back through `Number()`, so the tag must guarantee Latin digits and a 24-hour cycle. Nothing is shown to a reader. |
| `core` (outside) | `utils/number-display.ts` · `formatDisplayNumber`'s `catch` retry with `undefined` | The `catch` for a tag `Intl` itself rejected (a malformed tenant tag), retrying with every other option kept. Not in the census population. |

Reached only under a dropdown `captionLayout`, which no first-party caller sets; `formatters` is the declared override for a wrapper in `components/src/custom/`. ⛔ Not edited. |

Measured by reading the console's vite config: it declares no `rollupOptions.input`, so only `index.html` is a build entry (no build was run for this reading). |

| Package | Site | Why |
|---|---|---|

Measured with the tripwire on a provider-less `ResourceWorkload` mount: every call received `'en'`, none received `undefined`. Listed, not repaired. The comment beside it, which says the leg falls back to the browser locale, is false (Acceptance notes). |
| `plugin-gantt` | `ResourceWorkload.tsx` · `const locale = language \|\| undefined` | Same measurement. |
| `app-shell` | `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` · `toLocaleString(language \|\| undefined)` | Same `useObjectTranslation()` reasoning. |

## Contract changes (Clause-② at-tier review)

Additive only; nothing that compiled before stops compiling.

1. `@object-ui/types`: `ValidationContext` gains an optional `locale`.
2. `@object-ui/plugin-report`: `exportReport(format, report, data, config?, locale?)`, `exportAsHTML(report, data, config?, locale?)`, `exportAsPDF(report, data, config?, locale?)`, each defaulting to `DISPLAY_LOCALE_LAST_RESORT` (`'en'`). ⛔ Deliberately not a `ReportExportConfig` member, since that type is authored report metadata.
3. `@object-ui/plugin-report`: `LiveExportOptions` gains an optional `locale`, forwarded by `exportWithLiveData`.
4. Module-level, not package-exported: `plugin-charts`'s `formatterFor(format, locale)` now REQUIRES the locale.
5. Private `@object-ui/test-support` (never published): new exports `recordLocaleArguments`, `recordLocaleArgumentsAsync`, `isMachineLocale`, `LOCALE_TAKING_INTL_CONSTRUCTORS`, type `LocaleCall`.

## Evidence

- **Census ablation 1** (re-insert one bare call). `node ../objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` turned GridField's numeric `n.toLocaleString(locale)` back into a bare call (anchor 1 → 0, blob `bde59eed` → `3e15e4fe`). Census: `1 failed | 6 passed`, naming the re-inserted GridField call in its computed diagnostic. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, census `7 passed`. The first attempt used an anchor that missed; the tool refused to write, so it was a no-op and was re-run with the right anchor.
- **Census ablation 2** (the lit control). "Repairing" the `CommentThread` catch turns the census red on two tests: the lit control, and `declared 1, found 0`. Restored to HEAD.
- **Blanket ablation of every surface pin.** All 37 repaired source files were put back to BASE (on-disk blob == BASE blob on 37/37), with a trap restoring from HEAD. Result: 17/17 files red, 131 failed | 49 passed. On each of the 43 surfaces the de-DE face, the differential and the tripwire are all red; the en face stays green by design (the runner is en-US, so that leg pins must-not-change). Restore: 37 paths == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Single-site ablation** (useObjectChat auto-response stamp only). The de face and the tripwire go red. The differential stays green, because the sibling user stamp still differs. That is the direction that was observed.
- **Type-check** (`pnpm --filter … type-check`) passes for test-support, types, core, i18n, components, fields, plugin-charts, plugin-form, plugin-chatbot, plugin-report, plugin-dashboard, plugin-grid, plugin-designer, plugin-detail, app-shell and console, after a turbo build of the dependency closure.
- **Full suites of every touched package** were run from the repo root and are green: i18n, test-support, core and types (451 files); fields (176); components (286); plugin-charts, form, chatbot, report, designer and detail (459); plugin-dashboard (121); plugin-grid (147); app-shell (286 + 465 files); console (107). Dependents are green too: plugin-list, view, kanban and calendar (226); plugin-timeline, gantt, tree, react, layout, collaboration, ai, map, markdown, editor, mobile, permissions and providers (280); scripts, examples and other small packages (317).
- **Final-head union at `689004ac`**: 19 pin, census and tripwire files, 221 tests green. `check:control-bytes` OK, `check:new-line-citations` 0 new, `check-changeset-presence` OK, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask` OK, `check-changeset-no-major` OK. Also run: vi-mock-specifiers / inherit / override-shape, test-path-roots, phantom-deps, lint-coverage, type-check-coverage, unreferenced-sources, pending-changeset-literals, readme-exports (after building `@object-ui/cli`). All exit 0.
- **ESLint, narrowed to the 62 changed TS files**: `--no-inline-config`, 62 files by the JSON count, 0 errors. Every warning is pre-existing (`no-explicit-any` and hooks rules on untouched lines, plus 4 pre-existing `any`s on lines this diff re-flowed). This is a narrowed run, not the repo-wide lint, which belongs to CI. The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- Existing tests edited, and why: `normalizeChartSchema.test.ts` now passes `'en'` to `formatterFor` instead of relying on the runner's locale. Three suites that count `console.warn` in provider-less mounts (`AdvancedChartImpl.missingCategoryKey`, `AdvancedChartImpl.unprojectedSeriesDimension`, `useObjectChat.maxToolRoundtrips`) now mount under an en `I18nProvider`: a component that reads the display locale makes react-i18next print its once-per-module `NO_I18NEXT_INSTANCE` notice on a provider-less first mount, and those spies were written to count only the component's own diagnostics.
- ⚠️ Behaviour note: that same one-time react-i18next notice now also appears for a host that mounts one of these components with NO `I18nProvider` at all (the console always mounts one).
- `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` imports `useDisplayLocale` on its own line, because `marketplace-preview-namespace-3546` pins that page's `useObjectTranslation` import by its literal line.
- The pending objectui#9786 changeset named the deleted census file. Its prose is corrected, frontmatter untouched, which is the practice `check-changeset-claims` asks for. `check-changeset-overwrite` reports the edit (report-only, its "correcting a declaration on purpose" case).
- `ApprovalsInboxPage`'s relative-age tail formats with `language` (UI language) while this page's repaired faces use the display locale. Not machine-locale and not this class; noted as a channel mix on one page.
- `plugin-calendar`'s sub-views default `locale = "default"` (the disguised machine locale), but `CalendarView` always passes `effectiveLocale` and the sub-views are not exported. Unreachable today; noted.
- The `'¥'` currency prefix hard-coded in `GridField` and `MasterDetailForm`, and `plugin-timeline`'s `locale = 'en'` default, were noted by the earlier census and are unchanged.
- `@object-ui/core`'s `formatDisplayNumber` retry drops a malformed tag (machine locale), while `plugin-report`'s `formatNumberInDisplayLocale` degrades to `'en'`: two answers to the same question. The disagreement is noted, not changed.
- No `package.json` and no `pnpm-lock.yaml` change.
